# Built-in add-on packaging and add-on activation are separate scopes

The original build change registers a builtin-addons resource root and packages Thundermail extension/** into messenger.jar. Its exact backout removes those build registrations separately from the add-on source removal. Accepted source later gates the Thundermail child on not MOZ_ENTERPRISE. These build declarations establish packaging intent, not successful installation, startup, a paired upstream flag or network behavior.

Scope: Thunderbird built-in add-on build registration.
